The '''Vanik system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was where, according to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rumors, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had captured the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''.<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]''</ref>
